english.note: Use this relative-clause pattern when referring to a person previously mentioned, with the object understood inside the clause.

examples.english: The person whom I asked to come and help carry the bag just now is my older brother.
examples.traditional: 頭先我叫嚟幫手拎袋嘅人係我阿哥。
